name: Mo'grosh Stronghold
summary: Mo'grosh Stronghold looms over the northeastern hills of Loch Modan. The fortified ogre den is dug among ancient ruins, and its inhabitants threaten the dwarven settlements below.

sections.title: A Looming Threat
sections.body: Mo'grosh ogres raid supply caravans in northeastern Loch Modan. From their caves and outer camps, they threaten travelers and the peace of Thelsamar. Rugged stonework scattered around the camp points to an older settlement. The ogres claimed the site and raised their distinctive mounds.

faq.answer: The fortified ogre compound is dug into the hills of northeastern Loch Modan. The Mo'grosh inhabit its caves and surrounding grounds, forming the largest hostile ogre enclave in the territory.

faq.q: Who used to live here before the ogres?
faq.answer: The old stonework suggests a settlement stood here before the ogres, but its original inhabitants are unknown.

faq.q: Why are the ogres a problem for the dwarves?
faq.answer: The ogres' proximity to key travel routes makes them a severe hazard to local traffic and trade caravans moving through Loch Modan. Dwarven authorities call on adventurers to thin their numbers and keep the mountain passes safe.

angles.text: The Mo'grosh ogres constantly menace dwarven patrols and travelers. Eradicating their stronghold is a matter of civic defense for the Mountaineers of Loch Modan.
Keeping the Mo'grosh ogres in check helps secure Loch Modan and safe passage between Ironforge and the northern mountain roads.
